gate_equation_audit.actual_equation: g_res = np.clip(0.5 + gain_factor * pred_delta, clip_min, clip_max)
gate_equation_audit.discrepancy_note: Code strictly implements linear mapping with clipping: g_res = clip(0.5 + 2.0 * pred_delta, 0.15, 0.85). Stage 5A report text had written sigma(2.0 * pred_delta), but executable code uses linear mapping.

resnet293_l2_norm.source: L2 norm of raw output embedding vector from WeSpeaker ResNet293-LM before L2 unit-normalization.
resnet293_l2_norm.variance_assessment: Sufficient variance (std = 0.563, range [0.03, 3.42]). Strong correlation with confidence.

dfn_noise_reduction_db.source: 10 * log10(power(mono) / power(mono - dfn)) energy ratio on subsegment.

vad_conf_mean.source: Mean of frame-level speech posterior probabilities from pyannote VAD in subsegment window.
vad_conf_mean.variance_assessment: Near-zero variance in clean speech subset (mean = 0.957, std = 0.093, median = 0.999). 75% of clean speech subsegments have VAD confidence > 0.99.

leakage_audit.recording_weights: Inverse recording size (equal aggregate weight per training recording).
leakage_audit.prototype_construction: Leave-one-turn-out: query turn strictly excluded from target speaker positive centroid.
leakage_audit.negative_prototype_construction: All other multi-turn speakers in training set (strictly turn-disjoint).

multiscale_modeling_assumption.why_scale4: Scale 4 is the base resolution defining the N x N affinity matrix in offline clustering.
multiscale_modeling_assumption.application_point: Applied after multiscale cosine aggregation: A_fused = (1 - G) * A_zt + G * A_zr where G_{ij} = 0.5 * (g_i + g_j).
multiscale_modeling_assumption.status: Architectural modeling choice (subsegment-level gating applied to fused multiscale graph).
